title: A chart's filter choice is still set on your next visit
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians can clock time: Settings > Staff > open each staff member > Edit Staff Member, Clockable switched on, Active, enrolled in this workplace (e.g. Grace Sullivan and Nadia Petrov).
  5. At least two staff members act as service advisors on work orders (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen and Priya Raman).
  6. Use the same browser throughout (the choice is kept in this browser only).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. In the Technician filter keep only one technician ticked (e.g. Grace Sullivan).
  4. On the Billing Efficiency tile, click View details.
  5. In the Advisor filter choose one advisor (e.g. Marcus Halvorsen).
  6. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  7. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  8. Open the Technician Efficiency detail and read its filter.
  9. Open the Billing Efficiency detail and read its filter.
  10. Read the Technician Utilization filter (open its detail).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Technician Efficiency chart still shows only the technician you kept.
  • The Billing Efficiency chart still shows only the advisor you chose.
  • The Technician Utilization chart is unaffected and still shows all technicians, because each tile keeps its own choice.
